title: संस्कृत साहित्ये नैपालमिथिलाक्षेत्रस्य योगदानम् [Contribution of Nepali Mithila Region in Sanskrit Literature]
nepali: सूर्यवंशीयराज्ञो निमेः शरीरमन्थनाज्जातेन मिथिनाम्ना राज्ञा प्रवर्तितत्वात् तदीया राजधानी मिथिलेति प्रसिद्धिमुपगता । मिथिलायाः सीमासङ्कोचविस्तारयोर्जातेऽपि प्रवृmताध्ययने नेपालस्य साम्प्रतिकः द्विसङ्ख्यकः प्रदेशः मिथिलाक्षेत्रत्वेन गृहीतः । मिथिलाराज्यस्य सीमायाः परिवर्तने दृष्टेऽपि मिथिलासंस्वृते राजधानी जनकपुरं वर्तते । मिथिलायां वैदिककाले विश्वामित्रप्रभृतयो ऋषयो दृश्यन्ते । तेषु महर्षिर्याज्ञवल्क्यः सर्वाधिक्येन प्रदीप्तं मिथिलायाः प्रोज्ज्वलं रत्नं वर्तते । अर्वाचीनेषु कविषु वंशमणिशर्मा हरिकेलिमहाकाव्यमाध्यमेन सर्वोत्वृष्टं स्थानं लभते । मिथिलायां स्फुटरूपेण संस्वृmतकवितारचनायाः परम्परा सम्प्रत्यपि जीविता वर्तते । [This research confirms that the naming of the Mithila region was initiated by a king named Mithi, who was born by churning the body of Suryavanshi king Nimi. Although the border of Mithila has been constricting and widening over time, in this study, the current state number two of Nepal has been taken as Mithila region. Janakpur remained the capital of Mithilaculture even when the borders of Mithila state changed. Vishwamitra and other sages have been seen in Mithila during the Vedic period. Among them, MaharshiYajnavalkya is the brightest gem. In the modern age, it has been confirmed that Vanshamani Sharma has reached the best place through the epic Harikeli. This research has confirmed that the tradition of composing Sanskrit poetry in Mithila is still alive today.]
american_english: Because it was established by the king named Mithi, born from the churning of the body of the Suryavanshi king Nimi, his capital attained renown as Mithila. Even though the contracting and expanding of the borders of Mithila occurred, in the present study the current Province No. 2 of Nepal has been taken as the Mithila region. Even when changes were seen in the borders of the kingdom of Mithila, Janakpur remains the capital of Mithila culture. In Mithila during the Vedic period, sages such as Vishvamitra are seen. Among them, Maharshi Yajnavalkya is the most brilliantly radiant gem of Mithila. Among modern poets, Vamshamani Sharma attains the preeminent position through the medium of the epic Harikeli. In Mithila, the tradition of composing distinct Sanskrit poetry remains alive even today.
british_english: As it was founded by the king named Mithi, born from the churning of the body of the Suryavanshi king Nimi, his capital attained renown as Mithila. Although the contraction and expansion of the borders of Mithila took place over time, in the present study the current Province No. 2 of Nepal has been treated as the Mithila region. Even with changes witnessed in the frontiers of the kingdom of Mithila, Janakpur remains the capital of Mithila culture. Within Mithila during the Vedic era, sages such as Vishvamitra are observed. Amongst them, Maharshi Yajnavalkya stands as the most brilliantly radiant jewel of Mithila. Amongst modern poets, Vamshamani Sharma attains the pre-eminent position through the medium of the epic Harikeli. In Mithila, the tradition of composing discrete Sanskrit poems remains alive even today.
australian_english: Because it was established by the king named Mithi, born from the churning of the body of the Suryavanshi king Nimi, his capital became renowned as Mithila. Even though the contracting and expanding of Mithila's borders occurred over time, in this study Nepal's current Province No. 2 has been taken as the Mithila region. Even when shifts were seen in the borders of the kingdom of Mithila, Janakpur remains the capital of Mithilan culture. In Mithila during the Vedic period, sages like Vishvamitra are found. Among them, Maharshi Yajnavalkya is the brightest radiant gem of Mithila. Among modern poets, Vamshamani Sharma holds the foremost position through the medium of the epic Harikeli. In Mithila, the tradition of writing distinct Sanskrit poetry remains alive to this day.
informal_english: Because it was set up by a king called Mithi who was born from churning the body of the Suryavanshi king Nimi, his capital got famous under the name Mithila. Even though Mithila's borders shrank and grew over time, in this study Nepal's current Province No. 2 has been taken as the Mithila area. Even seeing changes in the boundaries of the Mithila realm, Janakpur is still the capital of Mithila culture. Back in the Vedic era, you see sages like Vishvamitra around Mithila. Out of all of them, Maharshi Yajnavalkya is hands down the brightest sparkling gem of Mithila. Among modern poets, Vamshamani Sharma takes top spot thanks to his epic poem Harikeli. In Mithila, the tradition of putting together separate Sanskrit poems is still well and truly alive today.
translator_notes: The source text is composed in academic Sanskrit with slight OCR typographical artefacts (e.g., प्रवृmताध्ययने for प्रकृताध्ययने, संस्वृते for संस्कृतेः, सर्वोत्वृष्टं for सर्वोत्कृष्टं), followed by an author-provided English summary in square brackets; the Sanskrit text was translated directly sentence by sentence across all 7 sentences, without relying on the bracketed summary as a substitute. Historical and literary names (King Nimi, King Mithi, Janakpur, Vishvamitra, Maharshi Yajnavalkya, Vamshamani Sharma, Harikeli) are transliterated consistently.
